prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms, strong silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: One round deep-purple wizard's cat familiar with exactly four paws, two ears and one curled tail, wearing a tiny crooked turquoise wizard hat. It has fallen asleep belly-down on an oversized open spellbook, hugging one glowing crystal ball with its two front paws. Book pages show ONLY abstract swirls and star doodles, no letters or runes. A sleepy little magical sparkle floats over its nose, warm comic scene, minimal backdrop.
